北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京小雨，记得带伞！气温 23℃，注意保暖别着凉哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Beijing, remember your umbrella! Stay warm and avoid colds.

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云体感 32℃。天气热，多喝水，小心别中暑！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, feels like 32℃. It's hot, remember to drink more water to avoid heatstroke.

广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 36℃. It's very hot, protect from sun and heat, drink plenty of water!

成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 34℃. It's a bit muggy, remember to drink more water and prevent heatstroke!
